story_so_far: Day 1: Hamid (Lahore) got 82% in 12th but the university fee is Rs 2,00,000 a year; he tore the admission form and wrote PLAN B. Day 2: first job at a chai dhaba, 12 hours; burned hand, broke a cup, paid Rs 450 (Rs 1,200). Bilal arrived with a 'paise double' scheme. Day 3: Bilal's scheme - they each put Rs 1,000 into 10 'cheap' phones at the bazaar; at home all were plastic dummies. Angry at first, then they laughed together on the rooftop. Rs 200 left. Diary: 'Aaj bhi bach gaye. Kal: teen naukriyan!'
